reasons.plausibility: Microalloying to strengthen interfaces and improve ductility matches established approaches in alloy design, though specific concentrations and interactions remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison between baseline and Nb-doped samples under controlled heat treatment is well-defined and capable of directly proving or disproving the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Targeting interface strengthening to mitigate cracking directly addresses the main limitation in eutectic HEAs and provides a clear, feasible approach worth investigating.
